newsitem.title: USA: US East Coast heat oil stocks up 1.4 mln bbl - EIA.
newsitem.headline: US East Coast heat oil stocks up 1.4 mln bbl - EIA.

text.p: Heating oil stocks in the critical U.S. East Coast region rose 1.4 million barrels to 29.1 million barrels last week from the week before, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said Thursday.

While total U.S. distillate stocks, including heating oil and diesel, dipped 500,000 barrels in the week ending November 1 to 114.5 million barrels, "the situation in PADD I (East Coast) appears to be improving," EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.
Heating oil inventories on the East Coast, which uses 75 percent of the product in the United States, were back to levels seen in late January.

Strong U.S. distillate demand of 3.7 million barrels per day was partly met with robust imports of 300,000 bpd last week, while production eased by 226,000 bpd to just under 3.6 million bpd, EIA said.
